# newer version exists to bump to - the fix, where one exists at all, requires the upstream
# image maintainer to rebuild against newer base OS packages). Each entry was reviewed with a
# local Trivy scan (matching this CI's exact scanner version, v0.73.0) before being added
# here, one image at a time.
#
# This file makes CI pass for these specific, already-investigated images without silencing
# the scan itself: Trivy still runs and reports findings in the job log for visibility, this
# file only prevents the job from *failing* the build over CVEs already confirmed
# unactionable. New CVEs discovered later on these same pinned images don't need a new entry
# here (they're covered by the same "no newer version available" reasoning) - but remove the
# entry (and re-verify locally with `trivy image ...`) as soon as the upstream project
# publishes a new tag/digest, so CI resumes enforcing this project's normal CVE bar for it.
#
# Format: one full image reference per line, exactly as printed by
# `docker compose config --images` (matched exactly, not by pattern, against the image the CI
# job is actually scanning).
